text:
TCK-001 (change): Tasks need a due date

I want to give a task an optional due date when I add or edit it. The list shows the date next to the task, and an open task whose due date has passed is marked overdue.

I saved the plan. It starts at **P1 (requirements)**, because the current requirements list "Due dates" as out of scope. That has to change before the design or code can.

**Requirements**
- Take "Due dates" off the out-of-scope list.
- Add two new requirements:
  - **Optional due date:** a task can get a due date when it's added. When it's edited, the date can be set, changed or cleared. Invalid dates are rejected, and the date is stored on the server.
  - **Display and overdue:** the list shows the date next to the task. An open task is marked overdue when its due date is before today's local date. Done tasks are never marked overdue.
- Update the add and edit requirements (REQ-001 and REQ-005) to mention the due date.
- The sort order in REQ-007 stays as it is.

**Design**
- The task record (DSN-005) gets an optional due date field.
- The controller, service and store (DSN-006 to DSN-008) change, including a new database column and a migration for existing data.
- The add and edit flows (SEQ-002, SEQ-004), the use cases (UC-001, UC-002, UC-004) and the browser page (DSN-003) are updated to match.

**Tests, code and check**
- New and adjusted tests in the UC-001, UC-002 and UC-004 test files.
- The code changes in the task files under `src/tasks-app/`, in `src/app/app.ts` and in `public/index.html`.
- A final full test run that also checks tasks without a due date still load and work as before.

The ticket didn't say how a few things should work, so I wrote these choices into the plan. Please correct any that are wrong:
- The due date is a date only, with no time.
- "Passed" means the due date is before today's date in your local time.
- The order of the list doesn't change.

The code currently matches the design, so this change doesn't start from any existing mismatch.
Close TCK-001 and write the change report.

I saved the change report for TCK-001 and the ticket is now closed. All 48 tests pass and typecheck is clean, with three tests still marked as todo, two of them manual browser checks.

**What the report covers:**
- **Requirements:** new REQ-009 (optional due date) and REQ-010 (showing the date and marking overdue tasks), and REQ-001 and REQ-005 now include the due date.
- **Design:** the overdue rule now runs on the server. The task list request takes the page's local date and returns each task with an overdue flag, using a new TaskView type.
- **Code:** stored tasks get a due date field, and databases created before this change are upgraded automatically. The page has a date field when adding and asks for the due date when editing.
- **Tests:** the existing tests were updated to the new method signatures, and new tests cover the new acceptance criteria.

**Still open:**
- **Server date fallback:** if a request leaves out today's date, the server uses its own date in UTC, not the user's local date. The page always sends the date, so only other API callers are affected.
- **Due-date-only edits:** editing just the due date loads the whole task list to keep the existing text.
- **No overdue flag after an edit:** the edit response doesn't include the overdue flag. The page reloads the list after each change, so users don't see a difference.
- **Visual criteria not in the design:** REQ-002 AC3 (how a done task looks) and REQ-007 AC1 (struck-through done tasks) have no class or method covering them. The TaskListView class the second review proposed is not in the final design, so these are checked by hand only.
- **REQ-003 note:** the requirements phase left a note about REQ-003, but it was cut off in what I received, so please check it yourself.
